summary: Northwest Natural Holding Co filed an 8-K on September 23, 2026, disclosing a settlement in the Texas general rate case of its wholly owned indirect subsidiaries SiEnergy Gas, Pines Gas, and Pines Gas Development, originally filed with the Railroad Commission of Texas on May 4, 2026. The stipulation, joined by RRC staff, served cities, and municipal parties, sets a revenue requirement increase of approximately $8.6 million, down from the requested $12.0 million, with 59.75% equity and 40.25% long-term debt capital structure, a 9.8% return on equity, and 8.0% overall cost of capital. Rate base totals roughly $343 million, a $177 million increase since 2023. New rates are expected November 2026, subject to RRC approval; this is a routine regulatory settlement, not a special situation.
